verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no production call-monitoring dashboard and no alerting on agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes for Pipecat or Pipecat Cloud. The built-in metrics are emitted data a developer would have to route into their own monitoring and alerting stack, so they count only as building blocks. Whisker is described by the community as a pipeline debugger, not a production monitor with alerts, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike
